## BigDecimal

9-digit operands, precision 28. libmpdec is the C library behind
CPython's `decimal`, timed without the interpreter.

| Operation | decimo | libmpdec | vs libmpdec | CPython `decimal` | vs CPython |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| add | 45.3 ns | 37.5 ns | 1.21× slower | 49.7 ns | **1.10× faster** |
| subtract | 47.1 ns | 37.3 ns | 1.26× slower | 50.9 ns | **1.08× faster** |
| multiply | 43.3 ns | 29.0 ns | 1.49× slower | 44.2 ns | parity |
| divide | 153.8 ns | 51.7 ns | 2.97× slower | 67.7 ns | 2.27× slower |
| round | 40.7 ns | 37.3 ns | 1.09× slower | 72.4 ns | **1.78× faster** |
| parse | 90.4 ns | 44.8 ns | 2.02× slower | 79.5 ns | 1.14× slower |

In place, where neither side allocates a result:

| | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x += y` | 6.7 ns | 8.9 ns | **1.33× faster** |
| `x -= y` | 43.9 ns | 9.3 ns | 4.74× slower |
| `x *= y` | 56.2 ns | 23.8 ns | 2.37× slower |

## sqrt, exp, ln, power

A fixed set, chosen before the results were seen, at three
precisions. `2.3456789`, and `**1.5` for power.

| Precision | operation | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 28 | sqrt | 2.55 µs | 861.4 ns | 2.96× slower |
| 28 | exp | 4.28 µs | 4.40 µs | parity |
| 28 | ln | 4.49 µs | 12.55 µs | **2.80× faster** |
| 28 | power | 10.90 µs | 34.76 µs | **3.19× faster** |
| 100 | sqrt | 4.59 µs | 4.14 µs | 1.11× slower |
| 100 | exp | 10.15 µs | 14.94 µs | **1.47× faster** |
| 100 | ln | 68.94 µs | 39.01 µs | 1.77× slower |
| 100 | power | 90.59 µs | 78.96 µs | 1.15× slower |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 52.47 µs | 214.09 µs | **4.08× faster** |
| 1,000 | exp | 384.14 µs | 4.45 ms | **11.59× faster** |
| 1,000 | ln | 2.83 ms | 5.58 ms | **1.97× faster** |
| 1,000 | power | 3.26 ms | 11.20 ms | **3.44× faster** |

## BigDecimal across operand sizes

Operand digits, not precision. Add and multiply are **exact** on both
sides (decimo `precision=0`, libmpdec `mpd_maxcontext`); divide targets
operand width + 8 digits on both. decimo's time, then how it compares.

Verified this run: both libraries produce the same 2000-digit
product from the 1000-digit operands.

| Digits | add | | multiply | | divide | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | 37.8 ns | 1.24× slower | 38.0 ns | 1.24× slower | 143.7 ns | 2.97× slower |
| 100 | 46.5 ns | **1.43× faster** | 110.3 ns | **1.39× faster** | 1.27 µs | 3.67× slower |
| 1,000 | 110.5 ns | parity | 2.58 µs | **3.42× faster** | 26.93 µs | 1.90× slower |
| 10,000 | 840.0 ns | 1.31× slower | 133.00 µs | **2.78× faster** | 548.90 µs | **2.28× faster** |
| 100,000 | 7.60 µs | 1.26× slower | 4.47 ms | 1.56× slower | 16.20 ms | 1.17× slower |

## BigInt against CPython's int

CPython's integers can only be reached through the interpreter, so
these include its overhead — read the large sizes as the real ones.

| Digits | decimo add | CPython add | | decimo multiply | CPython multiply | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 35.9 ns | 23.7 ns | 1.52× slower | 79.5 ns | 97.4 ns | **1.23× faster** |
| 1,000 | 50.4 ns | 84.6 ns | **1.68× faster** | 1.10 µs | 5.40 µs | **4.89× faster** |
| 10,000 | 270.0 ns | 793.2 ns | **2.94× faster** | 53.01 µs | 259.95 µs | **4.90× faster** |
| 100,000 | 2.40 µs | 7.75 µs | **3.23× faster** | 1.19 ms | 8.68 ms | **7.30× faster** |

## pi()

Each measurement in a fresh process, since mpmath and MPFR cache the
constant. Includes conversion to a decimal string, for every library.

| 100 | 7.09 µs | 43.38 µs | 40.04 µs | 32.04 µs |
| 1,000 | 64.28 µs | 98.29 µs | 70.21 µs | 164.88 µs |
| 10,000 | 1.23 ms | 855.46 µs | 672.04 µs | 5.76 ms |
